attributes.name: Double-Barreled Musket
attributes.powers: For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 2d4. You may additionally bury this card to add another 2d4. If you did not bury this card and would fail this check, you may discard this card to reroll the dice; take the new result. If you did not bury or discard this card, roll 1d6, or 1d12 if proficient with weapons; on 1-2, shuffle this card into your deck.
